purpose: Machine-readable official ECC capability matrix. IAF must remain additive unless a row is an explicit DEFAULT_POLICY disable.
invariant: UPSTREAM INPUT → IAF EXTENSION/ADAPTER → TARGET HARNESS preserves upstream capability unless harness cannot support it, security blocks it, IAF policy disables it, or upstream marks it optional/deprecated.

capabilities.iafBehavior: Rewrite generated copies only: execution model inherit when Claude aliases are not known usable; preserve UPSTREAM_PREFERRED_MODEL in comments and sidecar.
capabilities.why: Cursor maps sonnet/opus/haiku to Other Models. Inherit is execution compatibility, not deletion of the specialist or upstream sources.

capabilities.iafBehavior: Do not rewrite Claude model fields to inherit.
capabilities.why: Claude Code is the ECC reference harness.

capabilities.iafBehavior: Rewrite generated wrapper require/getPluginRoot paths so hooks resolve under .cursor/scripts. Do not remove hooks.
capabilities.why: Upstream wrappers require ../../scripts from .cursor/hooks, which resolves outside the adapter.

capabilities.upstreamSource: skills/ and generated adapter skill copies
capabilities.iafBehavior: Discover from the active harness. Do not bypass or delete skills.
capabilities.why: Capability routing consumes the installed catalog.
IAF does not replace the command catalog.

capabilities.iafBehavior: Add IAF alwaysApply overlay rules beside official rules. Do not delete official rules.
capabilities.why: Orchestration contract must be always-apply in Cursor.

capabilities.officialCapability: Official ECC MCP adapters including optional chrome-devtools
capabilities.iafBehavior: Default policy leaves optional chrome-devtools disabled via ECC_DISABLED_MCPS. Files and installer capability remain.
capabilities.why: Optional MCP credentials must not be enabled to green a report. Upstream MCP capability is not deleted.

capabilities.iafBehavior: Wrap official installer; never replace it. Prefer install-apply.js over install.sh to avoid lockfile mutation.
capabilities.why: Fleet/bootstrap must call the official installer.

capabilities.iafBehavior: Repair/rebind stale absolute roots after integrity checks, then official install/repair. Overlay-only is TEMPORARY_DEGRADED.
capabilities.why: Official state stores absolute target roots, so moved checkouts refuse reinstall.

capabilities.iafBehavior: Invoke official doctor; add IAF provenance/overlay checks. Do not replace doctor.
capabilities.why: Need both official drift detection and IAF overlay health.

capabilities.iafBehavior: Reject foreign Claude/Cursor IDs; use harness-default. Do not inject Claude IDs.
capabilities.why: Foreign model IDs are not executable on those harnesses.
